verdict.rationale: Yapily's core data/payments/consent operations are all exposed via the API (accounts, transactions, payment initiation, authorisations), and the Yapily Connect UI is explicitly a pre-built wrapper around the same API flows, suggesting API parity for core banking actions. However, evidence doesn't confirm that UI-only conveniences (e.g., branding/customisation controls in Yapily Connect, institution selection UX logic) are fully API-configurable, and the OpenAPI spec probe returned 404s, weakening confidence in complete self-service API discoverability. Missing for 10: confirmation that all UI configuration/branding options are API-settable, a working public OpenAPI spec link, and independent verification of full UI/API parity beyond vendor docs.
